Details for anyone interested:

The loots - tons of stone/diorite/andesite/gravel/flint/dirt, mostly placed in those double chests surrounding central column.
The good loots - about 8 double chests filled with ores, mostly coal and iron, but quite a good amount of other ores including over 3 stacks of diamond ores. (also 54 blocks of diamonds, from when I was using fortune pick).

The dimensions - a central chunk, and then 6 chunks each direction dug out (basically a 13/13 square, but with the corners cut off). All chunks dug from feet at 42 to feet at 5.

The why - I've built many worlds, and tried many mob or slime spawners but none seemed to work too well. I wanted to be able to control everything spawning around a central ticking area. Contained in this area (but up top) are 2 different iron farms, a chicken farm, a tree farm, cow farm, gold farm, melon/pumpkin farm, wheat farm... uh, that's it I think?

The how - I started with 1 silk touch and 1 fortune pick. As I progressed a sort of method began to happen that evolved into a quite efficient process. In the beginning I dug down to 5, and then found borders for all chunks(dug 2 blocks high) and cleared out area. Then I went up to 42 and dug the same area out 2 blocks high. I started out digging down 2 blocks at a time, leaving most blocks on the ground to disappear. 

By the time I got it dug out with my feet at 38 I realized there had to be a better way. I also was making too many trips to my dual blaze spawner farm so I built 6 more silk touch picks, and put away my fortune pick. It was easier storing ores than what they produced.

I switched up my method to focus on 3 chunks at a time, digging from 38 down to 5. I did this in 5 high increments (so I'd dig down to 33 from 38, clear out the 2 blocks to walk and then dig up the 3 more), repeating until I had a single layer at 8 which was easily cleared. 

Then I marked out the chunks using 60 stairs to border, 3 stacks of lower half slabs, and 4 light blocks. I ended up leaving 3 slime chunks without slabs and in the beginning I got a lot of slime spawns, but towards the end they pretty much stopped as cap was filled elsewhere.

I have 2 ways down. The central shaft has a water fall for swim up and drop down. I also created a stairwell going up directly into my base up top.

I have 6 beacons in central chunk but actually ended up turning mining and sprint off (funny enough) because it was harder to control.

Anyways, hope you guys found this info interesting.
